ansible._protomatter collection are installed; no community collections are installed.

Judge whether the request succeeds in this stated environment. Do not silently

Request: Delete the directory /home/mydata/web
Initial states: baseline: target directory absent; adversarial: target contains nested and hidden files.
Playbook:
---
- name: Candidate playbook
  hosts: all
  become: true
  tasks:
  - name: Delete the directory
    file:
      path: /home/mystate/web/
      state: absent
